name: Motorcycle helmet fatality rates by usage label
description: Motorcycle helmet fatality rates must use collisions.motorcycle_collision = 1 and collisions.motorcyclist_killed_count. Infer helmet usage only from parties.party_safety_equipment_1/2 text containing motorcycle helmet used / motorcycle helmet not used. Restrict to collisions that actually have a motorcycle-helmet equipment mention; do not treat every non-helmet motorcycle crash as helmet_not_used. Emit exactly two labels: helmet_used and helmet_not_used (underscores, lowercase). Fatality rate = 100 * sum(motorcyclist_killed_count) / count(distinct motorcycle collisions) in that helmet group.
sql: WITH helmet_collision_groups AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_1, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_2, '')) LIKE '%motorcycle helmet not used%' THEN 'helmet_not_used' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_1, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_2, '')) LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%' THEN 'helmet_used' END AS helmet_usage_group FROM parties p WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_1, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_2, '')) LIKE '%motorcycle helmet%') SELECT h.helmet_usage_group, COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS collision_count, SUM(COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0)) AS motorcyclist_fatalities, 100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS fatality_rate_pct FROM helmet_collision_groups h JOIN collisions c ON h.case_id = c.case_id WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1 AND h.helmet_usage_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.helmet_usage_group
